about: What building paper responses has taught us. A problem counts as learned only when it has a symptom, a cause, a fix and an automated guard that would catch it again (a QA check in modules/responses/qa.js or a named unit check in test/responses-unit.js). test/responses-unit.js fails if a guard doesn't exist. This is the pipeline's own record; the humans' agent log (AGENT_LOG.md) is separate and written only by them.

learnings.symptom: Picture ran 0.8 s short of the voice over a 72 s video.
learnings.cause: Each play and wait is rounded to whole frames; 50 rounded calls add up.
learnings.fix: The scene holds to one clock (the narration's) and waits until each line's end on that clock.

learnings.symptom: The narration read written labels aloud, brackets and all, and the first voice was robotic.
learnings.cause: Checklist labels were written for a page; espeak-ng was the only installed voice.
learnings.fix: Spoken phrasings per check (SPOKEN in plan.js); Kokoro neural voice by default, sentences cached by voice and text.

learnings.symptom: A 'partly supported' paper was planned as 'strong-table'.
learnings.cause: Five hand-named situations; the mapping only checked for thin and abstract-only, so any paper with a table counted as strong.
learnings.fix: Situations are composed from strength, table, toy and method (sitKey); the Q-learner uses a coarser class.

learnings.symptom: The model's assumed beat lengths were off by up to 1.9x (one claim: 7 s assumed, 11.9 s measured).
learnings.cause: Variant lengths were guesses; real lengths come from the voice.
learnings.fix: Measured lengths fold into modules/lab/production-calibration.json (running mean) and replace the guesses in A*.

learnings.symptom: Flow-box labels spilled out of their boxes; the gauge arc was hidden behind its ring; a gauge animation crashed the render.
learnings.cause: Text wasn't fitted to its box; draw order; fading a mobject that is redrawn every frame.
learnings.fix: Labels fitted to boxes, arc drawn above the ring, redrawn parts faded through a tracker.

learnings.symptom: The Q-learner's weekly reward ranged 3.2 to 5.0 across seeds and it made odd choices in rarely visited states.
learnings.cause: Too few updates for the state space, a high learning rate, and no account of how often a state was seen.
learnings.fix: 40,000 training weeks at a learning rate of 0.05, and the hand rule decides in states visited fewer than 30 times. Seeds now land within about 0.25 of each other.
learnings.guard: unit:the learned offering is stable across seeds and beats the hand rule

learnings.symptom: A* returned a worse plan than uniform-cost search.
learnings.cause: The lower bound for the last step was undefined, so f was NaN and the queue's order broke; an attention-bucket closed set also merged different histories.
learnings.fix: The bound past the last unit is 0, and the search keeps every path (attention depends on the whole history).
learnings.guard: unit:A* finds the same optimum as uniform-cost search in every situation

learnings.symptom: The learned offering 'never gives a thin paper the full video', which looks like a finding.
learnings.cause: It is the trust penalty we wrote into the reward; the learner only rediscovers it.
learnings.fix: Reports say the policy follows from the stated reward, and the unit check shows that without the penalty the learner does oversell thin papers.
learnings.guard: unit:without the trust penalty the learner oversells thin papers

learnings.symptom: The last 0.6 s (the closing card) was cut from video.mp4, and QA's blank check found an empty final frame.
learnings.cause: ffmpeg's -shortest ended the file with the subtitle track, whose last cue ends before the closing beat's tail.
learnings.fix: No -shortest; picture and voice are built to the same clock, so nothing needs trimming.

learnings.symptom: After the first calibration A* switched to claim chips and the bare score gauge: the variants it had never rendered.
learnings.cause: Only measured variants got their real (longer) lengths; unmeasured ones kept optimistic guesses, so trying something made it look worse than not trying it.
learnings.fix: Unmeasured variants are scaled by the mean measured/assumed ratio, so tried and untried options carry the same observed bias.
learnings.guard: unit:calibration scales unmeasured variants by the observed bias

learnings.symptom: The shipped video could silently drop a beat A* had planned (a quote card with no result sentence, questions with none open), while the plan still reported A*'s numbers.
learnings.cause: A* didn't know whether the paper had a result to quote or questions left open.
learnings.fix: Situations carry +res and +q; A* only offers what the paper can fill.
learnings.guard: unit:every beat A* plans is a beat the video shows

learnings.symptom: The Q-learner treated the last day of the week and the first as the same state.
learnings.cause: Days left wasn't in the state, so values mixed one-step and seven-step horizons and couldn't learn when to save budget.
learnings.fix: Days left (1, 2-3, 4+) is part of the state key.
learnings.guard: unit:the learned offering is stable across seeds and beats the hand rule

learnings.symptom: Policies were compared on different weeks, and 'overclaims' were counted for videos that never shipped.
learnings.cause: One random stream drove both arrivals and reward noise, and an over-budget action skipped its noise draw; the overclaim count ignored failure.
learnings.fix: Separate streams for arrivals and noise, the noise drawn first every time, and overclaims counted only when something ships.
learnings.guard: unit:every policy is evaluated on the same weeks

learnings.cause: The learned table is keyed by coarse class ('partial+visual'); the lookup used the full situation key.
learnings.fix: Look up by classOf(situation); one learned table per budget.
learnings.guard: unit:the plan names a suggested offering

learnings.symptom: Renders crashed for a toy check with no verdict, a curve with one point or all points at one x, and a one-step flow.
learnings.cause: Empty Text, a zero-width axis range, and a motion path through one point.
learnings.fix: A default verdict label, padded axis ranges, and a highlight instead of the loop for one step.
learnings.guard: unit:edge-case scenes are generated without zero-width axes or empty labels

learnings.symptom: Four ledger entries named unit checks that didn't exist.
learnings.cause: The ledger was written before its guards, and nothing checked it.
learnings.fix: test/responses-unit.js fails when any learning's guard is missing.
learnings.guard: unit:every learning has a guard that exists

learnings.symptom: QA's pace check kept failing after the voice was slowed twice, on 7- and 9-word lines.
learnings.cause: The check measured short phrases against a whole-narration speaking rate; short phrases are naturally spoken faster. The check, not the video, was miscalibrated.
learnings.fix: Per-line limits apply to lines of 12+ words; the whole narration is held to 130-185 spoken words a minute (the sample runs at 171).

learnings.symptom: The first recall run said the pace learning was forgotten.
learnings.cause: The recall test's corrected case was itself too fast (6 words in 1.3 s), so the guard failed on both cases; the test, not the memory, was wrong.
learnings.fix: A learning counts as recalled only when its guard fails on the mutant and passes on the corrected case; the fixture uses realistic timings.
learnings.guard: unit:recall by mutation catches every QA-guarded learning and passes every corrected case
